sqf: private _loc = (nearestLocations [[worldSize/2, worldSize/2, 0], ['NameCity','NameCityCapital','NameVillage'], 50000]) select {(toLower (text _x)) find 'mazem' >= 0}; if (count _loc == 0) exitWith {}; private _cityPos = position (_loc select 0); systemChat '[OPFOR Command] Deploying additional armor and APCs!'; private _vehicles = ['CUP_O_BMP3_RU','CUP_O_BTR80A_CAMO_RU','CUP_O_BTR80A_CAMO_RU','CUP_O_GAZ_Vodnik_PK_RU']; { private _spawnPos = [(_cityPos select 0) + (random 400) - 200, (_cityPos select 1) + (random 400) - 200, 0]; private _grp = createGroup EAST; private _veh = createVehicle [_x, _spawnPos, [], 0, 'NONE']; createVehicleCrew _veh; (crew _veh) joinSilent _grp; _grp setBehaviour 'AWARE'; [_grp, _cityPos, 200] call BIS_fnc_taskPatrol; } forEach _vehicles; systemChat '=== MAZEMOVO DEFENSE COMPLETE ==='; systemChat 'Deployed: 4x Tanks, 4x AA, 7x Static weapons, 4x Infantry squads, 4x APCs';
